resources.string: The Broadnet 5G preset requires one selected SIM identified as China Broadnet. Select that SIM and reload its configuration.

Prepares VoLTE, 5G NR including SA, VoNR and advanced calling for this Broadnet SIM. Preserves Wi-Fi calling and roaming Wi-Fi calling settings and manual drafts. Review all pending changes before applying; IMS registration also depends on the APN, device and network.
